column2: req_desc

First shot main journey
A new visitor who opens `/` with no session gets the tutorial table with no sign-up, completes a shot through the labelled controls, and sees the tutorial step readout advance.

First shot keyboard path
With keys only, using the published aim, spin and hold-release power shortcuts, a visitor completes a tutorial shot and the step readout advances.

First shot zero-power cancel
Releasing the power hold at 0% cancels the shot, uses no tutorial step, and posts the published cancel sentence in the table announcements log.

First shot phone path
At 375x812 portrait the tutorial table runs with its long axis vertical, no rotate wall, no sideways scrolling and every control at least 44 px, and a shot completes by touch alone.

Sign-up main journey
A guest who taps Play 1-on-1 and signs up in the sheet resumes at the tier picker, and Home then shows the published grant and the Starter Cue.

Sign-up keyboard path
The sign-up sheet keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside it, closes on Escape, returns focus to its opener, and its error summary links to each invalid field.

Sign-up age copy
A year of birth under 13 shows the published block sentence and creates no account, and a year under 18 shows the published note before the account is created.

Sign-up phone path
At 375x812 the sheet fits the screen, and reopening it during its closing motion keeps it open with no later re-hide.

Session API
The published sign-up and sign-in calls set the published session cookie, return the published bodies, and answer the sixth sign-in attempt in a minute with the published rate limit, as qualified in Business rules.

Lobby main journey
Home shows the avatar, display name, level, XP bar, Coins and Cash matching `GET /api/me`, unchanged after reload, with the first-match highlight for a player with no matches.

Lobby live chips
In two tabs of one player, a Refill or daily reward claimed in one tab updates the chips in the other without reload, and the fourth Refill of the day is refused with the published sentence.

Lobby keyboard path
The first Tab reaches the skip control, which moves on to the mode cards, and the cards then take focus in published visual order with a visible focus mark.

Lobby phone path
At 375x812 Home shows the published single-column order, the secondary row is reachable, and every target is at least 44 px.

Practice offline main journey
After one earlier visit and with the network off, Home shows the published offline state with online modes disabled, and a Rookie rack starts with no server call and earns nothing.

Practice screen-reader turns
The AI's Thinking state and finished turn are announced in the polite table log with published copy, and the turn text updates to match.

Practice keyboard and resume
Difficulty and start work with keys only, a shot can be played with keys, and leaving and returning offers the published resume prompt.

Practice phone path
At 375x812 and offline, practice setup and the table work with score and turn present as DOM text.

Stake tier picker main journey
The tier picker shows all five tiers with entry, pot and lock state, a locked tier shows its minimum level, and an unaffordable tier shows its shortfall with a Refill link or a Lower tier link.

Stake carousel keyboard path
Arrow keys move the tier carousel, Enter joins the queue on an available tier, and Escape or Cancel leaves the queue.

Stake carousel reversing motion
A reversed carousel move runs back from its current position with no jump, a swipe snaps to a tier on a phone, and reduced motion gives a plain crossfade with the same end state.

Stake pairing live update
Two contexts queued at one tier reach the same table address within 3 seconds with both Coin chips down by the entry and no reload, and Cancel before pairing debits nothing.

Stake table guards
The server enforces the published queue rejections, level band widening, mode unlock and second-device rule, as qualified in Business rules.

Table turns main journey
On a scripted table with two contexts, a shot by one player updates the other's turn, score and group text without reload.

Table foul announcement
A scripted foul shows the exact published reason in both contexts, is announced in the table log, and states ball in hand in text.

Table turns keyboard path
The shooter takes a whole shot with keys only, including ball in hand, while the waiting player's aim controls are hidden and inert.

Table turns phone path
The same scripted table at 375x812 keeps turn, score and group readable as DOM text with controls at least 44 px.

Server shot clock and reconnect
The shot clock and reconnect timers show the server's remaining time whatever the device clock says, a late shot is refused, and reconnect, forfeit and void follow Business rules.

Match result main journey
On a scripted table the winner pots the 8 in the called pocket, and both players see the result with the published Coin change, XP and reason.

Match result after reload
After reload, both players' Home and Profile show the Coins, level and win record of the same settled match.

Called pocket keyboard path
When a shooter's group is cleared the shot is blocked with the published sentence until a pocket is called by keys.

Result under reduced motion
Under reduced motion the result shows final numbers at once with no counting, a level-up lists its reward, and rematch is disabled with the published reason when funds are short.

Escrow and ledger lines
Each stake and settlement writes balanced lines, a wallet balance equals the sum of its lines in each currency, each match's escrow ends exactly once, and Profile lists the lines.

Shop main journey
Buying a Coin cue drops the balance, marks the item owned and lets it be equipped, and equipping mid-match changes nothing until the player's next match.

Shop keyboard path
Shop tabs move by arrow keys, and the item dialog keeps Tab inside it and returns focus to the item on Escape.

Shop exact text
Insufficient-funds and level-locked items show the published sentences, and the compare panel shows the published stat bonuses in the published format.

Shop phone path
At 375x812 the Shop shows its published grid, stat bars keep text values, and nothing scrolls sideways.

Cash pack main journey
A verified adult using the link from Mailpit buys a pack, sees `Confirming`, then the new Cash balance, and a receipt mail and a Kill Bill PURCHASE payment both exist.

Cash pack keyboard path
The payment dialog completes with keys only, focus stays managed, and the result is announced politely.

Cash pack eligibility copy
An under-18 player is not offered payment, and an unverified adult is sent to verify with a one-tap resend, each with published copy.

Cash pack outage screen
With Kill Bill unreachable the payment fails with the published sentence, nothing is credited, and the Shop stays usable.

Cash pack idempotent credit
A repeated request with the same `Idempotency-Key` credits once and records one Kill Bill payment, and a conflicting reuse is refused as published.

Friends main journey
A request by code is accepted and the friend appears in the list.

Friends live presence and invite
In two contexts, presence changes in the open friends panel within 5 seconds without reload, and the host's invite link brings both to the same table address.

Friends panel reversing motion
The friends panel slides in, closing it mid-flight reverses from where it is with no jump, and its contents are hidden and inert once closed.

Invite after sign-up on a phone
A logged-out person at 375x812 continues from an invite to the table after sign-up, and an expired link shows the published expiry word.

Clubs main journey
A player joins an open club, sees the roster and weekly score, and leaves, and the owner sees the published ownership rule and a full club gives the published refusal.

Clubs live messages
A preset message sent in one context appears in the other without reload.

Clubs keyboard role menu
A role change works through a menu with arrows, Enter, Escape and focus return, and is announced politely.

Leaderboard phone path
At 375x812 the leaderboard scope tabs work and the player's own rank row stays pinned in view.

Tournament main journey
Registering at a tier moves the entry out of Coins, and the bracket screen shows the published prize split.

Tournament live count
The entrant count updates without reload in a second context, and taking the last seat draws the bracket and begins the ready check on the page already open.

Tournament keyboard and screen reader
The 8-slot bracket is reachable in reading order, the ready control works by keys, and the check is announced.

Tournament phone and short window
At 375x812 the bracket scrolls inside its own region, and a window ending with fewer than 8 refunds every entry and says so with the published sentence.

Tournament prizes and refunds
Tournament APIs publish the exact prizes, exactly one entrant wins a last seat, and refunds write ledger lines, as qualified in Business rules.

Accessibility baseline
The main screens pass an automated WCAG 2.2 AA check and every focusable control shows a visible focus mark.

Published layouts
The table, rail and scoreboard layouts match the published arrangement at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1280x800, with no sideways scrolling on any main screen.

Mail outage screen
With mail unreachable, sign-up and play still work, Home and Shop show the published mail notices, and no success copy claims a mail was sent.

Postgres outage screen
With Postgres unreachable, Home shows `Could not reach the table`, a retry control, and cached values marked stale.

Settings persistence and mirroring
Settings survive a reload and reach the same player in a new context, left-handed mode mirrors the table controls, and the reduced-motion toggle acts as the device preference does.

Contact Loupe opens and locks
On the shooter's turn a pointer or aim key opens the Contact Loupe with its label and numeral in DOM text, locking draws the tangent line and freezes the numeral, and the shot receipt repeats the angle and first ball.

Contact Loupe reverses and rests
Unlocking during the draw reverses the tangent line from its current length with no jump, and under reduced motion the loupe and line appear whole with the same text.

Referee rulings
Scripted shots produce the published ruling for each foul, break outcome, group claim, 9-Ball case and win or loss reason, and a client cannot submit ball positions or outcomes.

Health and server boundary
The health route, size limits, content types, error shape, same-origin rule and refused paths behave as published in Server boundary.

Hall-lamp look
Every screen shows the near-black hall with one pool of lamp light on the table, tall condensed scoreboard counters, brass rulings and tabular figures.

Server authority and secrets
Source shows settlement, shot results and clocks decided only on the server, credentials read from the environment, and no provider call faked.
`/app/run.json` exists with string `install`, `build` and `serve` commands and `"_schema":"run-manifest-v1"`.

`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at `/app` lists the name, version and licence of every shipped package; shipped packages means the production dependency tree (`npm ls --omit=dev --all --json`) plus bundled fonts.
Shipped packages use only MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, 0BSD, CC0-1.0 or OFL-1.1 licences.
Postgres is the only datastore: no Redis, SQLite, message broker or extra running process.
`/app` contains no virtual environment and no absolute symlinks.
The app loads no script, font or style from another origin; all assets are served by the app.
The provided service configuration stays unedited.
